title: Sauerbraten German Beef Stew
description: A classic German beef stew marinated in vinegar, water, and spices, then slow-cooked to tender perfection. Served with a side of pilaf and steamed vegetables.
instructions: Marinate the beef in a large bowl with vinegar, beef broth, onion, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper for at least 2 days in the refrigerator.
Remove the beef from the marinade and place it in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the pilaf to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef for 3 hours, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board and slice it thinly against the grain.
Serve the beef with the pilaf and steamed vegetables.
Strain the cooking liquid and discard the solids.
Skim off any excess fat from the surface of the liquid.
Serve the beef stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
